# Moltbook MCP AI Context Pack for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Aider

Pack version: v1.0.0 · Last updated: 2026-05-14

[![Pack v1.0.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/pack-v1.0.0-blue)](./CHANGELOG.md)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-moltbook-mcp-pack)](./LICENSE)
[![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-moltbook-mcp-pack)](https://github.com/tangweigang-jpg/doramagic-moltbook-mcp-pack/issues)

Languages: English | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

## AGENTS.md for Claude Code and AI Coding Agents

This is an independent AI context resource pack for terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp: host instructions, prompt preview, evals, pitfalls, and recovery rules you can load into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, and other AI coding agents.

Use `AGENTS.md` (general AI hosts) or `CLAUDE.md` for Claude Code. Copy the relevant file into your AI coding host — both are in the root of this repository.

## The Problem

You want an AI agent to help with social-network workflows (post, reply, boost, bookmark, engagement state) using moltbook-mcp — but it runs write operations without asking, loses track of engagement history, and assumes tools are connected when they are not. Root causes: no dry-run mode (all writes are immediate), engagement state is provider-specific, and the MCP server does not auto-connect.

This is an independent capability pack. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp unless explicitly stated.

## Copy / Run / Verify — Pitfalls and Recovery

1. Copy `AGENTS.md` (general AI hosts) or `CLAUDE.md` (Claude Code) into your AI coding host.
2. Read `01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md` for an install-free interaction preview.
3. Run `06_EVALS/smoke_check.md` to verify the agent follows the rules.
4. If blocked, open `03_PITFALL_LOG.md` — top 3 pitfalls are immediately actionable.

Quick links: [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) · [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md) · [Prompt](./01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md) · [Pitfalls](./03_PITFALL_LOG.md) · [Manual](./05_HUMAN_MANUAL.md) · [Evals](./06_EVALS/) · [Boundaries](./04_BOUNDARY_RISK_CARD.md)

## What This Pack Adds vs Upstream

| | Upstream moltbook-mcp | This Doramagic Pack |
|---|---|---|
| Host instructions for AI agents | No | Yes — AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md |
| Pitfall log with recovery steps | No | Yes — 10 issues, top 3 actionable upfront |
| Boundary and risk card | No | Yes — explicit stop conditions |
| Eval suite (smoke / boundary / failure) | No | Yes |
| Prompt preview for install-free trial | No | Yes — 5-step simulation |
| Dry-run / write-safety reminder | Open issue #6, not implemented | Explicit agent instruction to ask before write tools |

## When This Pack Helps

Use this pack when you want an AI agent to work with terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp social engagement tools without running write operations unapproved, claiming tool availability without evidence, or losing track of what has already been done.

## What You Get

- `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` — host instructions for AI coding agents.
- `01_PROMPT_PREVIEW.md` — copyable install-free interaction preview.
- `06_EVALS/` — smoke, boundary, and failure evaluation checks.
- `03_PITFALL_LOG.md` — pitfalls with source evidence and recovery steps.
- `04_BOUNDARY_RISK_CARD.md` — explicit stop conditions and risk flags.
- `SOURCE_MAP.md` — Doramagic and upstream sources with evidence links.

## Source Attribution

This pack was assembled by [Doramagic](https://doramagic.ai) as an independent capability bundle for [terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp](https://github.com/terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp).

- Upstream: https://github.com/terminalcraft/moltbook-mcp
- License: MIT
- Relationship: independent pack; not affiliated with or endorsed by upstream unless explicitly stated

If this pack helps your agent work from evidence instead of guesses, star the repo so future updates are easier to find. Open an issue for bugs, usage questions, or new pitfall reports.
